svg.text: Damper lip foam: cutting templates, full size (mm)
Print at 100 % (Actual size, not Fit to page); the bars at the bottom must measure 100 and 50 mm.
Foam: closed-cell neoprene sheet, 1/16 in (1.6 mm), self-adhesive. Cut 2 of each lip, one per duct.
Both shapes are symmetrical, so they can be traced on the backing paper. Cut on the solid outline.
Straight-ish ends: toward the shaft. Long outer arc: against the bore wall.
R 31.4 to R 37, ends 7 from the shaft axis
R 44.41 to R 52.33 about the apex (= 31.4 and 37 x 1.414)
Short arc: inner edge of the cone. Long arc: against the bore wall.
If a bar is off, the printer scaled the page: reprint at 100 % (in some PDF viewers: Page Sizing, Actual size).
Generated by tools/lip_templates_svg.py from the window_vent.scad defaults (duct 74, lip width 5.6, gap 7).
